title: Déjà Vu: Multilingual LLM Evaluation through the Lens of Machine Translation Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Round-trip translating evaluation prompts to simulate 'translationese' and measuring how these translation artifacts systematically alter LLM-as-a-judge win rates between models across different languages.
Varying the presentation order of compared systems in LLM-as-a-judge evaluation prompts to measure inconsistencies and systematic shifts in pairwise win rates.
Comparing the pairwise preferences of different automatic LLM judges (e.g., GPT-4o vs Gemini 1.5 Pro) on the same outputs to identify discrepancies in model evaluation outcomes.
Bucketing pairwise model win rates by prompt length to analyze if certain models have a systematic advantage on shorter or longer text generations.
